identity.lineage: The owner asked what a link would look like if today's shift times carried no weight in the league, every other rule still applying, with three weekday rules: every closer from 15:45, no shift over 9 hours and no opener over 8h 30m. A first search with two 13:45 finishes every weekday (Clean Sheet, not shipped) needed two 9-hour lates every weekday to meet the contract; with one 13:45 a weekday (owner: "only 10 13:45 finish openers", ten a year each) nothing goes over 8h 30m Monday to Saturday. Searched over every weekday total the rules allow and laid on the twelve sets of weeks in this folder, it keeps every rule, no fatigue factor on the fixed duties, and Even Step's days in a row, weekends, rest, leave and late finishes, with 19 weeks on one shift time. Against Even Step it fits the trains more closely (30.3 · 8.4 · 26.4 against 32.6 · 10.0 · 29.0) with a week-to-week change of 1h 21m against 1h 31m, for 17 shift times, 10 not worked today, against 13 and 5, and Sunday openers 15 minutes shorter.
